adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration builds raw SQL with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` where `h` comes from the `site_settings` table (`embeddable_hosts` split by newlines). If any stored host value contains a single quote (or other SQL-significant characters), this will break the SQL, and it also creates an injection vector within the migration because the value is not quoted/escaped via bind params or connection quoting.
